seo.title: Points & payments | TripAgent
seo.description: Your bank points and your card, in one clear transaction. Sell prices only. No hidden markups. The fee shown before you confirm.

hero.lede: Years of earning, spent like cash. Points and card together, in one clear transaction. Nothing hidden.

howItWorks.lede: Points are valuable and rarely explained well. We make yours the simplest part of the trip. You pay the smart way; we do the maths.

steps.heading: Tell us your cards & programmes
steps.body: Once. We note your cards and programmes: bank, airline, hotel, and keep them on file for every trip.

steps.heading: We find where points beat cash
steps.body: For each fare or room, we find where your points are worth most, and where they are better kept. You see the recommendation, not a spreadsheet.

steps.heading: Pay points + card, one transaction
steps.body: Settle your split in one clear checkout: points for one part, card for the rest. Taxes and any fee shown, before you confirm.

steps.heading: Earn where it's smart
steps.body: The card part keeps earning as usual. When it is wiser to earn than to spend, your advisor says so.

worked.headingHtml: A business-class fare, paid the smart way.
worked.lede: An illustration, not a quote. Your advisor builds the real split around the points you hold.
worked.note: Figures are illustrative and rounded. Points value varies by programme; your advisor confirms the exact split and rate before you confirm.

whatWorks.heading: The currencies we put to work.
whatWorks.lede: The reward currencies Indian travellers actually hold: banks, airlines, hotels. Tell us yours; we tell you where each goes furthest.

tiles.heading: Leading Indian bank reward programmes
tiles.body: The points and miles your premium and co-branded cards earn, put to serious use against real travel.

tiles.heading: Major airline & hotel loyalty
tiles.body: Frequent-flyer miles and hotel points, applied to fares, rooms and suites: including award space when it's better value.

tiles.heading: Transfer partners
tiles.body: Where moving points between programmes is worth more, we map the route, so a balance in one place can pay in another.

whatWorks.note: Programmes and eligibility vary, and are confirmed for your cards and bookings. Categories shown are indicative, not a list of partnerships.

transparency.headingHtml: What you're quoted is what you pay.
columns: Sell prices only. The real price of the fare or room: never quietly inflated on its way to you.
No hidden markups. Taxes and airline charges itemised. Nothing buried in the total.
The fee is disclosed first. Any service fee is shown before you confirm, never after.
Secure by default. Payments run through Razorpay on PCI-DSS compliant infrastructure. We never store your full card details.

items.summary: Can I mix points and cash?
items.bodyHtml: Yes. Almost any booking can be part points, part card, in one checkout. You choose the split, or your advisor suggests one: all points, all card, or anything between.

Leading Indian bank programmes, major airline and hotel loyalty, and, where they help, their transfer partners. Tell us what you hold; we'll tell you where each one is worth using, and where it isn't.

items.summary: Do I still earn points when I pay?
items.bodyHtml: Yes. The card part earns as usual. Where it is smarter to earn than to spend, your advisor will say so.

items.summary: Is there a markup on what I pay?
items.bodyHtml: No hidden markup. Sell prices, taxes and charges itemised, any service fee shown before you confirm. What you are quoted is what you pay.
Yes. Payments run through Razorpay on PCI-DSS compliant infrastructure: a regulated Indian gateway. We never store your full card details.

cta.headingHtml: Let your points carry you further.
cta.lede: Once you're a member, your advisor maps your programmes the same day, so your next trip is paid the smart way.
